seo.title: Marine R&D and CFD Simulation | Lasan Marine Co., Ltd.
seo.description: Ship CFD simulation, hydrodynamic and structural analysis and measurements for fishing and passenger vessels — verify a design before it is built.

fields.headline: Research & Development (R&D)
fields.lead: Getting to the bottom of engineering problems that need simulation, measurement or deeper verification. From a specific question or hypothesis, we choose the right method — CFD, structural analysis, measurement, testing or data analysis — to clarify the problem and check it against real data where possible.

link.label: What do you need to find out?

fields.heading: What do you need to find out?

items.problem: I need to compare hydrodynamic options
items.context: When the effect of a change in geometry or operating condition can't be judged by eye, CFD can compare resistance, flow field, loads and related quantities.

items.problem: I need to check the flow or cavitation around a propeller
items.context: Simulation can show the pressure and velocity distribution and the unfavourable flow regions, to support the assessment of a design.

items.problem: I need to check structure or vibration
items.context: Numerical analysis identifies stress, deformation, vibration characteristics and the areas that need closer checks under specific load cases.

items.problem: I need to verify with real data
items.context: We can measure geometry or real operating parameters to compare against the design and check how well the calculation model fits.

Velocity, pressure, stress or other fields to be assessed
Comparison between options or operating states
Comparison between simulation, measured data or reference material
A technical report setting out method, assumptions, results and model limits

fields.heading: Simulation results depend on the quality of the model
fields.content: We control geometry, mesh, boundary conditions and convergence criteria. Where measured data or reference results exist, they are used to validate the model. The report also states the assumptions and the limits of the results.
